kind_note: Reasoning tier of GPT-5.6 Sol: a multi-agent 'ultra' mode, not a separately shipped model. Lab OpenAI and kind 'tier' are confirmed.
note: No source gives a release date for Ultra itself. The base model GPT-5.6 Sol went to general availability on July 9, 2026: 'GPT-5.6 went to general availability on July 9, 2026' (https://digitalapplied.com/blog/gpt-5-6-sol-terra-luna-public-ga, opened). That page also says the June 26, 2026 preview was limited to API and Codex access for invited partners; this is the base-model preview, not an Ultra-specific one. Ultra's own status is contested. Techsy (https://techsy.io/en/blog/gpt-5-6-sol-ultra-codex, opened, July 2026 coverage) says Sol Ultra was in closed preview for roughly 20 government-approved partners, that it was gated behind a government safety review, and that OpenAI had published no general-availability date for it. The digitalapplied page, written at the July 9 GA, says ultra is available in ChatGPT Work for Pro and Enterprise plans and in Codex from the Plus tier up, with no separate Ultra date. The two sources conflict, and both are from July 2026. I could not confirm whether Ultra was ever opened to the general public, or when, as of 2026-10-14. The OpenAI primary announcement was not found in search, so no OpenAI page was opened. A 'July 7' date for Ultra circulates and Techsy flags it as unconfirmed; I did not use it.
